objective: Implement a local-only Project Intelligence agent context export that summarizes graph snapshot state, product surfaces, current/next goal state, blockers, safe next candidates, and non-authorization boundaries for Codex / AI IDE consumption.
acceptance: Add a local CLI script such as pnpm project:intelligence:agent-context.
Read the existing project-intelligence-snapshot.json or generate it when explicitly requested.
Write ignored local JSON and Markdown context exports under artifacts/project-graph/.
Include product surfaces, active/next goal, findings summary, blocker summary, safe next candidates, and non-authorization boundaries.
Cover schema, Markdown readability, redaction, no external references, and no target repo writes with unit tests.
